summary: The Crew entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Crew
entries.definitive_edition: No official playable definitive edition after March 31, 2024; preserve historical PC/console captures and build data

emulation.notes: Always-online server shutdown blocks official play.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Historical official PC/console build before March 31, 2024

primary.version: Historical PC release; official servers shut down March 31, 2024
primary.why: The Crew is now a preservation warning case: Ubisoft delisted the game and shut down the online servers on March 31, 2024, making the official game inaccessible on every platform. Archive work should document historical PC footage/builds and any future verified preservation route, not present it as currently playable.
primary.how_to_play: No official playable route exists after the server shutdown. For archive documentation, record owned install/media, last known build, footage/capture source, platform, DLC/Calling All Units/Wild Run state, account state, and whether any preservation server route has been verified.
